First release candidate for VerdantVice, a farming and trading plugin for Paper/Purpur.

This is a **prerelease**, not a stable release. Back up your server and try it on a staging server before installing it in production.

## Changes

- Starter equipment is available from the herbalist, including the selection wand, manager table, drying rack and care tools. Larger shop catalogs have working pagination.
- Contract objectives follow merchant progression and available genetic batches. Expired active contracts no longer occupy the player's contract limit.
- Farms retain the actual manager-table location after restart. Co-op membership and storage changes no longer overwrite newer permission updates.
- Hiring a worker with a plantation contract works before the merchant menu handles the click. Workers use the farm owner's asset permissions while keeping the actual hirer as their salary payer.
- Product use in empty air works without bypassing explicit item-use restrictions from protection plugins.
- Newly created genetic strains can be priced and sold without restarting the server.
- Anti-dupe enforcement is disabled by default. Item signatures, ownership checks and durable transaction receipts remain in place.

Repository documentation is in English; the plugin retains its six Minecraft translations.

## Downloads

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `VerdantVice-1.0.0.jar` | Install this plugin JAR on the server. |
| `VerdantVice-resourcepack-1.21.4.zip` | Optional resource pack for Minecraft 1.21.4 clients. |
| `VerdantVice-resourcepack-26.2.zip` | Optional resource pack for Minecraft 26.2 clients. |
| `SHA256SUMS` | SHA-256 checksums for the three files above. |

The internal plugin version remains `1.0.0`; the GitHub tag and prerelease label identify this candidate. Do not install a thin JAR, test probe, source archive or both resource packs together.

## Installation and upgrades

1. Stop the server and back up `plugins/VerdantVice/`, including the database and signing key. Preserve the external database as well if using MySQL or MariaDB.
2. Put `VerdantVice-1.0.0.jar` in `plugins/`, replacing the old VerdantVice JAR. Keep the existing data folder and signing key.
3. Use Java 25 for Paper/Purpur 26.2, or Java 21 for the 1.21.4 compatibility target. Choose the resource pack matching the client version.
4. Start the server and confirm `Plugin enabled successfully.` in the log. Use `/vv guide` for the gameplay introduction.

SQLite and physical emeralds work without optional economy plugins. Existing configurations are preserved: check `security.anti-dupe-enabled` if you want enforcement disabled on an upgraded server. Do not use `/reload` to replace the plugin.

## Validation

- 724 local JUnit tests passed, with no failures, errors or skipped tests.
- [GitHub verification](https://github.com/Obs1dianByte/VerdantVice/actions/runs/40136115331) passed on Windows and Linux with Java 21/25, including real MySQL and MariaDB integration tests.
- The release JAR passed 500 assertions on Paper 26.2 build 87 with Java 25 across a controlled restart.
- The same source version passed 372 checks in a vanilla Minecraft 26.2 client as a non-operator Survival player, including farm creation, processing, trade, contracts, genetics, worker hiring and restart persistence. That client run used a separate local build, supplied currency, a configured merchant tier, prepared terrain, accelerated timers and peaceful difficulty.

Release assets are copied unchanged from the successful GitHub build of commit [`b2291e7`](https://github.com/Obs1dianByte/VerdantVice/commit/b2291e788c0fc2a0548895c3f8c8b5420a5ab9ae), with their checksums verified before publication.

## Remaining validation

Paper/Purpur 1.21.4 and Purpur 26.2 are compatibility targets, not locally verified runtimes for this candidate. Optional Vault/provider, PlaceholderAPI and protection-plugin combinations were not rerun against this build. Multiplayer load testing and a full natural-speed progression run are still outstanding.

Folia, Spigot and CraftBukkit are not supported. See [TESTING.md](https://github.com/Obs1dianByte/VerdantVice/blob/b2291e788c0fc2a0548895c3f8c8b5420a5ab9ae/TESTING.md) for the test boundaries. Report problems with the server version, Java version, plugin list, relevant log and reproduction steps; do not upload signing keys or private databases.
